# Third-party patches

Wave 1 contract generation has no local third-party patch. This directory is the
exclusive home for a reviewed, hash-pinned patch when a native generator cannot
be consumed unchanged.

## Local Patch Inventory

No third-party patches are currently applied. Additions require an immutable
upstream source identity, patch digest, rationale, and compatibility review in
`patches.lock.json`; the build must consume that exact locked patch.
